timing.training_loop_definition: Training for 2000 steps log to Saving final checkpoint at step 2000 log; includes first-step compilation and midpoint save, excludes startup and final save; log timestamps have 1-second resolution
timing.logged_elapsed_caveat: Reference elapsed_sec is host wall time before logging; M6 deferred logger uses CUDA-event step timing. These aggregates are diagnostic and are not an apples-to-apples speedup.
